title: 0004 Recipe Details View
description: Non-runnable container for all beads delivering spec-0326bd4c. Assembles the RecipeDetailSheet modal from a RecipeHeroHeader, RecipeStatStrip, RecipeTagChips, a segmented tab control, IngredientsView / CookwareView / StepsView tab bodies, and a pinned RecipeBottomBar — all driven by the parsed Recipe from CookbookCore. Shared Scale @State owned by RecipeDetailSheet flows as bindings into IngredientsView's header picker and RecipeBottomBar.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads completed and passing.
RecipeDetailSheet presents as a .large sheet from the recipes list with working swipe-down and X-button dismiss.
All three unit-test files pass via xcodebuild test.
xcodegen generate runs successfully and the build target includes every new Swift file.
